scripts.postbump: V=$(jq -r .version crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/package.json) && sed -i '' "s/^version = .*$/version = \"${V}\"/" Cargo.toml && sed -i '' "s/^i18n-next = { version = \"=[^\"]*\"/i18n-next = { version = \"=${V}\"/" crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/Cargo.toml && cargo update --workspace && cargo test -p i18n-next --test version_sync && git add Cargo.toml Cargo.lock crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/Cargo.toml crates/tauri-plugin-i18n-next/package.json
